menu.label: JellyFrame
viewContainer.title: JellyFrame
configuration.title: JellyFrame
configuration.repoRoot: Optional absolute JellyFrame repository root. Leave empty to discover it from the current workspace or extension.
configuration.buildDir: Optional absolute or repository-relative desktop runtime output directory. Leave empty to auto-detect a compatible build.
configuration.openCaptureAfterRun: Open a generated capture after preview or frame-script execution.
configuration.pythonPath: Python executable filename available on PATH, or an absolute path to a Python executable, used to run tools/jellyframe_cli.py.
configuration.defaultTarget: Default built-in target profile. App commands also list target profiles declared by the current App manifest.
configuration.fontBudget: Glyph estimate size in WIDTHxHEIGHT positive integers, for example 16x16.
configuration.deviceProvider: Absolute path to an installed Device OS provider executable. Leave empty until a supported developer image provider is installed.
configuration.deviceManifest: Optional absolute or repository-relative Developer Image manifest JSON file used to verify discovered device identity.
